name: Render 'Your fastest path to production' OG card by render.com
description: A dark share card that splits the canvas into a quiet typographic left half and a decorative data-mosaic right half. A small wordmark anchors the top-left corner while a three-line white headline in a light geometric sans carries all the focal weight. The right side is a bleeding grid of hairline-outlined dark tiles, a few filled with purple-to-mint gradients striped with horizontal bars that read as abstracted terminal output.
